title: History of Golden Friendship Masonic Lodge No. 40
subtitle: OUR LODGE STORY
body:
Origins & Foundation

Golden Friendship Masonic Lodge No. 40 began as the shared vision of the dedicated Master Masons from Cagayan de Oro and surrounding communities across Northern Mindanao under the leadership of the great three (3) lights, IPB Roque T. Mahilum Jr. 33° - Worshipful Master, Bro. Romeo Paradillo Jr. 3° - Senior Warden, and Bro. Mhelpher D. Umalay, 6° - Junior Warden.

United by a desire to build a fraternal home rooted in brotherly love, relief, and truth, the founding brethren submitted their petition for dispensation to establish the lodge under the jurisdiction of the Most Worshipful Sovereign Independent Grand Lodge of the Orient‑Philippines (Federation). It operates under a Carta Patent issued by the Supreme Council of the 33rd Degree in Occitania, France, and the Grande Loge Nationale des Rites Maçonniques (France), following the Ancient and Accepted Scottish Rite tradition.

Following review and formal approval by its governing jurisdiction, the lodge was duly constituted and consecrated. Later, on 06 September 2026, Golden Friendship Masonic Lodge No. 40, Inc. received its Certificate of Incorporation from the Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission, granting it official juridical personality as a non‑stock fraternal corporation on 12 October 2026.

Early Years & Growth

In its formative years, the small circle of founding brethren gathered regularly for stated meetings, the study of Masonic landmarks, and to receive worthy new candidates into the Craft. The lodge adopted the name “Golden Friendship” — a lasting reminder that true Masonic light shines through sincere, enduring fellowship that transcends differences in background and profession.

As time passed, the lodge grew in membership and community presence. Its brethren engaged in outreach and charitable relief work for those in need, and maintained fraternal visits with sister lodges throughout Mindanao. At all times, the lodge upheld the ancient landmarks of Freemasonry, respecting the sovereignty of every regular jurisdiction while strengthening its own bond of unity.

Core Mission & Legacy

To this day, Golden Friendship Masonic Lodge No. 40 stands as a beacon of light in Northern Mindanao. Its purpose remains unchanged: to improve the character of its brethren, teach moral virtue, and serve the wider community with charity and goodwill.

The lodge continues to honor its three founding brethren by preserving ancient Masonic traditions, studying the timeless landmarks of the Craft, and building stronger golden friendships among all who seek greater light.

So Mote It Be.
